name: Iseya Saki
source:
"To help our marriage, why don't we try doing it 'without the real thing' for now?"

The wife of a neighbor couple living in the same apartment complex as the Yoshioka couple.
She is a voluptous woman who exudes a seductive atmosphere, but she is also quite easy-going regarding sex and will have relations with anyone she likes. 
Her married life is good, and they seem to have frequent sex without any major fights

[Translated from [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc036/syoukai.html]the official site[/url]]
